1719-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-3499-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4812-8095.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-2866-4247-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-2511-4446.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1745-4695-8089.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

206-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

104-3129-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-3129-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3703-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3703-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-1472-5626-5686.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5626-5686.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-2757-7065.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1418-1651-4426-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-4426-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-4426-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

5686-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1355-1978-5143.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1355-1978-5143.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4289-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4375-5400-6797.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

856-2921-4231-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2084-3130.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

950-4613-5251.easyPrerequisites:
Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord does not have summoning sickness.
950-4613-5251.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-4613-5251.description:
Activate a creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Emmara.
Activate Emmara using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

222-4647-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling, and at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-4647-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1530-1949-4608.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
Paradox Haze attached to you.
1530-1949-4608.description:
At the beginning of your first upkeep, Second Chance, Starfield of Nyx and Paradox Haze triggers.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Paradox Haze trigger, causing you to get an additional upkeep step after this one.
Resolve the Starfield of Nyx trigger, returning any enchantment from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your second upkeep, Starfield of Nyx triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1458-2617-4829.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
At least eight of your ten sticker sheets have a name sicker with four unique vowels.
1458-2617-4829.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U} targeting Midnight Guard.
Cast _____ Goblin by paying {2}{R}.
_____ Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Midnight Guard.
Resolve the _____ Goblin trigger, getting a name sticker and adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, returning _____ Goblin from the battlefield to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheets.
Repeat from step 2.

2205-4050-4275-4852.notablePrerequisites: Imperious Perfect and Elvish Mystic do not have summoning sickness.
2205-4050-4275-4852.description:
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Imperious Perfect by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding one mana of any color.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Faces of the Past, untapping all Elves and Warriors.
Repeat.

2414-2689-3368-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
2414-2689-3368-5231.description:
Cast Thud by paying {R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Thud and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Thud copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding seven {R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Thud and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Thud copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

1694-3011.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
1694-3011.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you equal to a quarter of your life total.

1331-1495.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.
